reviews.title: Best value for the cost!
reviews.comment: I have only had the keyboard for a couple days- so I will come back and update if anything changes. But this seems like the best deal available right now. Even being refurbished the keyboard appears to be in excellent shape. For anyone looking to get into a gaming keyboard I would highly recommend this deal. Great value for the insanely low cost. RGB is bright and the keys are super sensitive.
reviews.author: Bridger & Taylor

reviews.title: Fine keyboard but had to replace the first. Second with same problem.
reviews.comment:
The first one I ordered had a gunked up/glitchy volume knob that would change around the pc’s levels randomly. Either you can lube that yourself but risk making it unreturnable or just get it replaced.
Update: Good value but it happened again so maybe it's the inherent product that's vulnerable to volume knob inconsistencies. Some people fix it by putting some tissue in it but we shouldn't have to.
reviews.author: Corey OD
